correctness.rationale: Exact Fourier–Zak transform and unitary normalization determine the true optimal frame bound; the real two-pole numerator gives zero loci only at z=±1. For every fixed frequency, the affine numerator/convex quadratic denominator concavity argument rules out smaller interior angular values. The two endpoint frequency profiles are monotone or unimodal with an explicitly dominated third endpoint. This proves both exact branches and the unique optimum. The standalone standard-library script replayed 154988 finite checks, not used as proof.
